items.title: Ciena (CIEN) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh AI Demand And Supply Limits
items.summary: Ciena’s updated analyst model now reflects a fair value move from US$565.71 to US$551.86, signalling a modest reset of price expectations. This shift comes as recent research highlights a wide spread of views on where the stock should trade, even with many analysts pointing to strong AI and data center demand, solid order backlog, and ongoing supply constraints that influence reported results. items.title: Ciena (CIEN) Lifts Guidance As Its Rich Valuation Faces A Reality Check
items.summary: Ciena (CIEN) is back in focus after issuing fresh guidance that pegs fourth quarter 2026 revenue at about US$1.75b, with a margin of plus or minus US$50m, alongside higher full year revenue expectations. Ciena’s latest guidance comes after a sharp pullback, with the share price falling 10.36% in the last day and 34.97% over 90 days, even though the year to date share price return is 29.02% and the 1 year total shareholder return is 171.52%.
